q1_issues.issue: The bare-plural group agent takes a distributive predicate (each band reinforces the lantern), so the instruction set's group doctrine calls for the per-member `(Implication (PartOf $x sk_band_1) ...)` rule alongside the group event, and it is absent — arguable only if reinforcement is read as an aggregate contribution.

notes: Everything else conforms: `iron_band` fused with genus `band` and no `iron` modifier genus (noun modifier), `stilllight_lantern` as one opaque name symbol with its separate `lantern` type atom, transitive inanimate subject as Agent, treatment verb object as Patient, and no status atom on the unmarked present.
